title: Research on Yeast Saccharomyces and Sulfonium Compounds
summary: This cluster revolves around the study of Yeast Saccharomyces and its relation to sulfonium compounds. Dequin S and Rouillon A are involved in studying genetic bases and sulfonium, respectively. The process of S-adenosylmethionine and S-methylmethionine permeases is studied in relation to Yeast Saccharomyces. Additionally, researchers Lord ND, Norman TM, and Paulsson J have studied Yeast Saccharomyces. The study of genetic bases involves DMS precursor S-methylmethionine. The research methods used include Food Microbiol.
